source.note: combo witness of the cast -> cast-trigger EDGE (CR 603.2). Displacer Kitten (oracle: 'Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, exile up to one target nonland permanent you control, then return that card to the battlefield ...') projects the cast TRIGGER consume (live label trigger:cast:spell:controlled -> stem cast, control=you) + emit:blink:permanent. Conviction (oracle: '{W}: Return this Aura to its owner's hand.') is a self-bouncing NONCREATURE spell whose return-to-hand is projected emit:cast:spell (the recast) + a pay:mana:white activation cost. Peregrine Drake ('When this creature enters, untap up to five lands.') is the blink target that refunds mana. Loop: cast Conviction -> Displacer's cast trigger blinks Peregrine Drake -> Drake's ETB untaps up to five lands -> mana pays {W} to bounce Conviction -> recast Conviction -> re-fires the cast trigger. All ports AST-derivable (Displacer's cast trigger, Conviction's emit:cast:spell, Drake's etb+untap all served Green in the CardAtlas dump). PARSE OVER-APPROXIMATION recorded honestly: the live cast-trigger label drops 'noncreature' (widened to any cast you make); the recast emit is bare emit:cast:spell (loses that Conviction is a specific noncreature Aura). Neither approximation is relied on for the tier -- the AMBER floor is the recast mana co-cost (guard:recast-pays-mana, ADR-0003 §8), which is sound regardless of the dropped type facets. popularity 9 is the reconstructed combo popularity COUNT from the dump (a demand.witnessed count, not an edhrec rank).

Displacer Kitten.note: THE CAST TRIGGER (consume side of the witnessed edge) - 'Whenever you cast a noncreature spell' (CR 603.2), a player-action subscription on the bare EVENT verb cast. Live label trigger:cast:spell:controlled decodes to stem cast + control=you. The 'noncreature' narrowing is NOT in the served label (a lossy parse that widens the watched scope to every cast you make); carried as an over-approximation note, not as a subtype attr, so the gold does not claim a facet the parser cannot derive.

the load-bearing RETURN half of the blink ('return that card to the battlefield'), stem=deployment (permanent-level: Displacer blinks any nonland permanent, so it is not narrowed to deployment:creature). manner=blink mirrors deadeye-x-peregrine-drake.D4. The exile half is its removal[manner=blink] twin (Deadeye-witnessed), omitted as non-load-bearing for this gold's cast witness.

Conviction.note: the {W} activation cost of the return ability ('{W}: Return this Aura...'). This is the mana co-cost the loop must refill each iteration (the §8 balance target).

THE RE-CAST (emit side of the witnessed edge). '{W}: Return this Aura to its owner's hand' bounces Conviction to hand so it can be cast again; the parser projects this self-bounce as emit:cast:spell (Green in the dump - the recast projection, a known-thin area that IS derivable here). Subject is self (this Aura, a specific noncreature) but the served label is bare 'spell'; control=you (you recast your own returned Aura -> the caster is you). Carries the pay:mana co-cost (CV1 + the {1}{W} recast cost) that guard:recast-pays-mana caps.

Peregrine Drake.note: Flying - incidental context (an already-witnessed stem); mirrors deadeye-x-peregrine-drake.PD0.
the ETB trigger 'When this creature enters' - a self-watching subscription (mirrors deadeye-x-peregrine-drake.PD1).
'untap up to five lands' (mirrors deadeye-x-peregrine-drake.PD2); the mana enabler feeding Conviction's {W} co-cost.

notes: internal: the cast trigger's payoff IS the blink of a nonland permanent
internal: the ETB untaps up to five lands
internal: paying {W} returns the Aura to hand, enabling the recast (CV2)

THE WITNESS: emit:cast (a re-cast noncreature spell) -> trigger:cast ('whenever you cast a noncreature spell', CR 603.2). A recast IS structurally a cast event feeding a cast-watching subscription (subsumption); control=you on both sides.

AMBER floor = guard:recast-pays-mana: the recast re-pays Conviction's mana cost each iteration (§8 mana balance); the loop can only refill it through the AMBER untap->mana bridge (E3), so the repetition vector is not provably >= break-even.

Additionally over-approximated (not relied on for the tier): the served labels dropped 'noncreature' from the trigger and narrow the recast to bare 'spell' -> bare spell does not provably Subsume 'noncreature spell' either (Overlaps).

blink IS a deployment (structural half = subsumption); PD1 self-watches and Displacer blinks 'a nonland permanent' -> Overlaps not Subsumes -> AMBER. Reuses the deadeye-x-peregrine-drake blink->etb shape.
untap != mana; irreducible cross-resource bridge; untapped lands' colors/count unknown (CR 107.4) -> AMBER ceiling. Reuses deadeye-x-peregrine-drake.E2.

guards.desc: a recast emit (emit:cast - a spell bounced/returned to a castable zone and cast again, CR 601) re-pays the spell's full mana cost every iteration. A cast-loop that is closed BY a recast therefore carries an irreducible mana co-cost: the loop is sound (GREEN-eligible) only if it provably refills that cost; unrefilled - or refilled only through an AMBER mana bridge (untap->mana) - the loop floors to AMBER (ADR-0003 §8 mana balance). Caps the cast->cast-trigger edge that the recast closes.

assertions.because: the recast mana co-cost (guard:recast-pays-mana) is refilled only through the AMBER untap->mana bridge (E3) -> §8 repetition vector not provably >= break-even
guard:recast-pays-mana: the recast re-pays mana each iteration; sound floor independent of the dropped-noncreature parse over-approximation
a re-cast IS structurally a cast event feeding a 'whenever you cast' subscription (CR 603.2); control=you on both sides
self-watch guard: blink of a nonland permanent Overlaps Peregrine Drake's self-watching ETB
CV2 projects the EMIT side of the cast verb (a recast), complementing aang-the-last-airbender's consume-side (trigger) witness; the cast->cast-trigger edge is now witnessed end to end
